tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// mkha' 'gro rlung 'khor bcas chog ma bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru/ rlung 'khor yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro rlung 'khor bcas chog ma zhes bya ba 'di yi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi cho ga'o// sngon 'gro ni bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag cing rlung khang bca' ba ni/ zhag dus tshes grangs bzang por rlung khang gru bzhi pa gzhal yas khang gi dbyibs can gcig bya/ nang du srog shing gi 'dzugs lugs khri lta bu can gcig byas la/ srog shing bzhi btsugs nas 'khor lo cha bzhir bskor ba dang*/ srog shing sgo lta bu gcig byas te 'khor lo cha gcig tu bskor ba'i lugs gnyis yod pa la/ lag len ni/ rlung 'khor la bar thog gcig byas te/ steng khang du 'khor lo/ 'og khang du rlung gshog /rlung gshog gi thad du rlung sgo yong bar bya/ srog shing ni smyug rgod la byas pa yar sna mar sna gnyis la lcags kyi thur mar bkar/ srog shing la shor bzhi brus te/ rlung gshog bzhi spyin dang sbyar/ de rnams kyi bca' lugs mchod rten dang khang pa'i khyad ma gtogs/ mchod rten gyi nang du bca' ba'i 'khor lo dang 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'khor lo bri ba dang*/ bskor zhing sgrub pa'o// dang po 'khor lo 'bri ba ni/ 'di'i lugs la/ phrin las bzhi char phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa'i man ngag go /rtsa ba'i 'khor lo bco brgyad/ sku gsung thugs dang tshe sgrub kyi 'khor lo 'o// (ka)dang po skyob pa gdugs kyi 'khor lo ni/

mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor ba'i lte ba la/ a/ de'i mtha' la oṃ ya hūm̐/ sa hūm̐ ṣ+ṇi ṣa ma ṇa dza la su pra ti/ puṣ+ṭiṃ bha ba ti ba ti dz+wa la swā hā/ bris/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nām/ na maḥ.a pra ti ha ta sha sa nā nāṃ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hāḥ bris/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i/ shar du 'khor lo/ shar lhor dpal be'u/ lhor rgyal mtshan/ lho nub tu pad+ma/ nub tu gdugs/ nub byang du bum pa/ byang du dung*/ byang shar du gser nya rnams bri/ rtsibs mchan brgyad la sā dhu zhes pa dang*/ sdug bsngal nyes byas rnams las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes btags pa bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ gdugs dkar gyi yang snying: tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai re bai re/ sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhī na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/yi bar bris pa'i sham bur che ge la mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes bri/ mu khyud lnga pa la rten 'brel snying po bri/ gnam lta'i 'khor lo yin pas yig mgo nang bstan bya/ (kha)gnyis pa gnyen po thog zer gyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhis bskor ba'i lte ba la/ gshin rje sku gsung thugs kyi snying po 'di bri/

oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhan+dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+riḥwī kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ rta mgrin dang phyag rdor gyi snying po 'di bri/ oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka /pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma kro ta/ pad+mān+ta kṛta ha ya gh+rī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ rtsibs bcur byas pa'i/ shar dang por/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa bh+ra mā rā dza ye phaṭa/ shar ltar/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa in+d+ra rā dza ye phaṭa/ shar lhor/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ag+ne rā dza ye phaṭa/ lhor/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ya ma rā dza ye phaṭa/ lho nub tu/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa nṛ te rā dza ye phaṭa/ nub tu/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa wa ru ṇa rā dza ye phaṭa/ nub ltar/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pṛ ti wi rā dza ye phaṭa/ nub byang du/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa bh+ya bhe rā dza ye phaṭa/ byang du/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ku be rā dza ye phaṭa/ byang shar du/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa i shwa ra rā dza ye phaṭa/ ces bri/ rtsibs mchan rnams la/ dhā na de wa phaṭa gzir gzir bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ srid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams gzir gzir/ dregs pa can dang drag po chen po dang*/ bsod nams can dang*/ yon tan can dang*/ dbang thang can dang*/ mthu btsan nus stobs can dang*/ shes rab can dang*/ gdug pa can ma rungs pa dang*/ phyug cing dar ba la sogs pa/ mtho dman che chung thams cad la gzir gzir/

a tri nri trig nan ma nu ṣe a ma nu ṣe trig nan zhes bri/ phyi rol la me ri bri/ yig mgo phyir bstan la g.yas skor du bri'o// (ga)gsum pa sbyin pa spel ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte ba la/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzungs/ oṃ ā mo gha pā sha ma hā na dā na pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ da ra da ra/ bhi ba dhe/ tsi tsi tri ma sarba pa pa ta u pa bho ga sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā dā na pā ra mi tā pū tsa me gha pra warta ya/ ta ra ta ra/ ta ra ya/ ta ra ya/ ma hā pad+ma ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bdag gi 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgyu 'bras thams cad 'phel bar gyur cig /puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ tad+ya thā/ i mi ri mi ri/ dha na mi ba hūm̐ phaṭa: lam bha ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ dhā na dhā na/ ma hā dā na bud+dhi war+dha ni dā na pā ra mi tā puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ mu khyud gsum pa la/ rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i shar du/ oṃ dā na dā nā/ byang shar du/ ma hā dā na/ byang du/ pā ra mi tā/ nub byang du/ spel spel/ nub tu/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ lho nub tu/ ku ru/ lhor/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ shar lhor/ swā hā rnams bri/ rtsibs mchan rnams la/ ma hā puṇ+ye/ tsin+dha ma ṇi/ gu ṇa rat+na/ s+pha ra ṇa hi mam/ ga ga na kham/ bhud+dhi dā ni/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye/ swā hā/

bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ oṃ dhā na pā ra mi tā/ puṇ+ye/ rat+na gu ṇa ma hā puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bdag cag sbyin pa'i dngos po dang*/ spel ba'i 'bras bu thams cad 'phel zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces yig mgo nang bstan du bri'o// de'i phyi rim du rin po che'i gzugs bris pas bskor/ (nga)bzhi pa 'bru 'phel pa'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ bha gu na ma bhe ḍa ma su gha ge swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ tog gzungs nas bshad pa'i dge sbyong me tog gi 'bru phul ba'i gzungs 'di bri'o// tsa me kha tsa me kha tsa me kha bi bri ta ha te/ ba ha ba ha ba ha/ sma ra ā sma ra kā na/ sa ra tre bi/ ba ba sa be/ sa ra sa ra/ in+t+ra ni sa ra/ ma hi na tri/ sa ra badz+ra na tre ta ra pa badz+ra na tre/ ta ra pa ya/ a s+pha ka na hu hu hu hu hu hu a sang ga dza be/ ta kha ta kha/ ba yu ba he/ u pa na ma/ san tar+pa ya/ bi dza pha la puṣ+pa/ oṃ kha dhi dha na dha n+yen/ tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣa ye dza la ba bha ha ni/ sma ra a sma ra ka na samyag pra ti sa nan/ sa ya sa ṭa ta ka li ya ma me/ ma mid ma mid tsa ba ra swā hā/ dge sbyong me tog gis ston pa 'od srungs la 'bru phul ba'i sngags so// mu khyud gnyis pa la oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ bhi min pa ra ma yu bha ga swā hā/ bdag gi 'bru'i bye brag rnams phung po chen po 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig

/'phel nas mi nyams par gyur cig /ces bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i shar du/ sad+yā the dan/ shar lhor/ dzi ni gh+ri ni sarba/ lhor/ ar+tha sā dha ni/ lho nub tu/ sha shi ni a la na/ nub tu/ ma mo nā sha ya/ nub byang du/ sid+dh+yan+tu/ byang du/ man tra/ byang shar du/ pa das swā hā/ zhes bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ dzaṃ bha sid+dhi ma hā sid+dhi spel spel/ zhes bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ s+y+t+yā the dan/ pra ti pu tsur+ṇa/ tsa ri sa man+ta/ dar sha ne/ ma hā be ha rā ga ti/ sa man+ta/ bi ma na ga te/ ma hā kāt+ya/ pra ti ṣa pra bha na swā hā/ bdag cag gi bang mdzod rnams gang ba dang tshad med par 'phel zhing mi zad par gyur cig /'bru'i sid+dhi puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ma hā sid+dhi pha la a la la hoḥ zhes bri/ de'i phyi rim la snye ma mang po 'khrigs pa bri/ yig mgo phyir bstan bya'o// (ca)lnga pa kha drag dpung skyed kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte ba la/ a lnga dang*/ 'go ba'i lha lnga dang*/ chos skyong srung ma rnams dang*/ drag cing che ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la kha drag gi dpung chen po bskyed du gsol/ nges par yang dag par bskyed du gsol/ zhes bri'o/ rtsibs brgyad la/ dza ya bha ba ti su pra ti dza bha ba ti/ zhes tshan pa brgyad bri/ rtsibs mchan rnams la/ dza ya zhes pa bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ oṃ yak+ṣa dha na de wa sarba pra ti pañtsa 'go zhing sdongs grogs byed pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/

drag cing che ba'i lha dang chos skyong thams cad kyis bdag dus dang rnam pa thams cad kha drag gi dpung pa dbang gi rgyal po chen po'i dngos grub stsol cig /bdag kun las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod cig /gzhan thams cad rab tu pham par mdzod cig /ces bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ tad+ya thā/ dza ya dza ya dza ye ma hā dza ye/ dza ya bha ga wa ti ye bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhi te dharmā a bha ba sa ni bud+dha a dhi ga me dz+nyā na a ba bha se swā hā/ dza ya ka ri/ dza ya ku ru/ ta ra ta ra/ ma hā tā ra ṇi/ ku ṭe ku ṭe badz+ra ku ṭe swā hā/ bud dhe bud dhe su bud dhe su bud dhe bud+dha bha ti bud+dha a wa bha ba ti dharmā bha ti sa ma hi ti sa ma ḍh+ri gar+bhe bud+dha sa ri ha ri dharma a wa bha sa ni swā hā/ zhes pa bri/ de'i phyi rim la me ri 'bar bas bskor/ yig mgo nang bstan bya'o// (cha)drug pa khrom zil gnon gyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ ya sha ni dun tri dun tri phob nya tsha shor ni khug /dun tsa le ma le ku ru swā hā/ khrom thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ khrom thams cad bdag gis zil gyis non zhing 'chug mi shes par gyur cig /mu khyud gnyis pa la rtsibs brgyad du byas la/ khrom thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru zhes pa re re bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ ṇi hrī hrī hrīḥs dhu zhes pa re re bri/ de'i phyi rim mu khyud gsum pa re mig brgyad du byas pa la/

khrom thams cad zil gyis gnon par gyur cig /ces pa re re bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ tad+ya thā/ ru ru tsa ra tsa ra ru sha hūm̐ nā ga bhi dha ra bhi dha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsa tra pa tra mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tad+ya thā dza yan te bi dza yan dza ye bi dza ye dzi te a dzi te ma ra se na pra mar+dha ni ye swā hā/ khrom thams cad dus dang rnam pa kun tu bdag gis zil gyis gnon par gyur cig /'chug mi nus par bdag gis zil gyis gnon par gyur cig /ces bri/ de'i phyi rim me ri 'bar ba bri/ yig mgo phyir bstan du bya'o// (ja)bdun pa lha dang 'khon sbyong ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ sarba de ba pañtsa bi ma la bi shud+dhe swā hā/ lha rnams kun nas bdag la mnyes par gyur cig /bri'o// mu khyud gnyis pa la/ oṃ de wa pañtsa lha 'khon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ lha rnams mi mnyes pa'i rgyu rkyen thams cad gtan nas dag par gyur cig /ces bri/ mu khyud gsum pa rtsibs lngar byas pa la/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ oṃ a de ba srog lha'i 'khon thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /oṃ tri de wa pho lha'i 'khon thams cad gtan nas dag par gyur cig /oṃ sha dhe wa yul lha'i 'khon= oṃ yu de wa dgra bla'i= oṃ na de wa ma lha dang zhang lha'i 'khon thams cad gtan nas dag par gyur cig /rtsibs mchan la/ 'khon thams cad dang nyams grib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la yig brgya dang dme brtsegs kyi sngags ni/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ ma hā pra ma ṇa ye/ bhurtsi bhurki bi ma le u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dme brtsegs sogs grib sel gyi sngags gang lcogs bri/ mu khyud lnga pa la/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas pa la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams dang khyad par brten cing sgrub pa'i lha rnams dang chos skyong srung ma rnams dang*/ 'go zhing sdongs grogs byed pa'i lha rnams dang mtshungs shing 'brel pa'i lha ma srin mi ma yin pa rnams dang*/ mi mnyes pa'i rgyu rkyen 'khon grib sogs thams cad gtan nas byang zhing dag par gyur cig /ces bri'o// de'i phyi rim la/ 'od dkar po 'bar ba bri zhing*/ yig mgo nang bstan du bri'o// (nya)brgyad pa lha dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi ru bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ āḥ'ago ba'i lha rnams badz+ra sa ma ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de wa sarba kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha lhan pra sha ta ā be sha ya a a ā/ zhes bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa rtsibs lnga ru byas pa la/ a oṃ de wa pañtsa pi tsu bha wa te zhes pa re re bri/ de'i sham la shar nas rim bzhin du/ oṃ bud+dha bai ro tsa ni ye oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na sam+bha we trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a mi de wa hrīḥ

oṃ karma a mo gha sid+dhi/ zhes bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ 'go ba'i lha lnga dang srung ma rnams ches sdongs grogs byed par gyur cig /ces pa re re bri'o// mu khyud gsum pa la/ oṃ de wa pañtsa hūm̐/ 'go zhing sdongs grogs byed pa'i lha dang srung ma chos skyong thams cad dang*/ oṃ yak+sha ba su de bā ya/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ las dang smon lam dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i lha rnams skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar bdag cag la ches shin tu mnyes te 'go zhing sdongs grogs chen po khyad par can byed par gyur cig e ma ho/ zhes bri'o// mu khyud bzhi pa la/ oṃ a de ba srog lha dang srung ma rnams ches shin tu mnyes te stongs grogs= oṃ tri de wa pho lha rnams= oṃ sha de ba yul lha dang gnas lha gzhi bdag rnams= oṃ yu de wa dgra bla rnams= oṃ na de ba ma lha mo sman zhang lha dang rigs la sdongs grogs byed pa'i lha rnams ches shin tu mnyes te thugs brtse bas mi 'bral bar stongs grogs byed par gyur cig /ces bri'o// de'i phyi ru 'od 'phro ba bri'o// yig mgo phyir bstan bya'o// (ta)dgu pa 'di la gnod sbyin rang gang mos kyi 'khor lo
yig mgo nang bstan du/

'bri'o// (tha)bcu pa dngos grub byin 'beb kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ hrīḥm hā su kha sid+dhi ma sid+dhi pha la sid+dhi su pra sid+dhi bud+dhe sid+dhi/ tsu ru sid+dhi/ ā we sha ya a a āḥ ces bri'o// mu khyud gnyis pa rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i phyogs bzhir/ sarba ma hā sid+dhi pha la dza hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa tshar re bri'o// mtshams bzhir/ shar lho nas rim pa bzhin/ ā yuḥdz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye/ ba su nā nā kha dhe dharmā/ saṃ bho shrī gu ṇa swasti/ ma nu ṣ+ya a ma nu ṣ+ya kīrti te/ zhes pa bzhi po re re la sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ āḥzhes btags pa bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ nor lha dang lha ma srin dregs pa can rnams kyi rtsa sngags la ma ma la sid+dhi pha la dzaḥhūm̐ āḥbatags pa bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ oṃ bi sid+dhi/ ba su nā nā kha dhe/ dharma sid+dhi/ ting ti pa hu ta sid+dhi/ sid+dhi sā dhu ma hā puṇ+yai/ ā yuḥdz+nyā na su pra ti rat+na sid+dhi pha la hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥdha na me dhi ni ye swā hā/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma satwa ma hā sid+dhi pha la dzaḥhūm̐/ ā be sha ya a a āḥ bdag cag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsol cig /mu sā ra phob cig /a la la hoḥ zhes bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad du byas pa re re'i mgo la/ oṃ yak+ṣa dha nā de wa sarba zhes pa re re'i mjug la/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du/

bo dha sang gha sa bam dur dza hūm̐/ a gu ta/ u tra ni/ 'du 'du hūm̐ dza dzaḥ nri dza nri dza hūm̐ dza bud+dha shrī ni/ bi ṣa ya dza ya dza ya/ sid+dhi sa ma ya dzaḥ aṃ gu sha dzaḥ nṛ dzaḥnṛ dza hur hur dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ mo baṃ du gzir shi sha bha ba ni hūm̐ nṛ dza hūm̐/ rat+na kaṃ kaṃ shab+da bud+dha hūm̐ nṛ dza hūm̐/ gho ra hasti baṃ baṃ hūm̐ dza dza hūm̐ dza dzaḥ dharma dhā tu pā sha dza saṃ gha aṃ gu sha dzaḥ zhes bri/ mu khyud lnga pa la/ mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i dngos grub gang 'dod stsol cig /ces pa'i 'dod gsol rnams bri/ phyi rim la 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khyil bas bskor ba yig mgo phyir bstan bri'o// (da)bcu gcig pa khams gsum dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ dha na de wa sarba lo ka sarba pā sha dzaḥ tsit+ta dkrugs dkrugs hrīḥhrīḥdza dzaḥ sdus sdus/ 'gro ba mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyi snying dung dung breng breng*/ khug khug /nṛ a tri dzaḥ 'gro ba rnams a kar+sha hrīḥdzaḥ lus ngag yid gsum aṃ gu sha dzaḥ a tri nṛ hur dzaḥ skye 'gro 'dod pa'i yon tan dang bcas pa thams cad/ che ba/ grags pa/ yon tan can dang*/ bsod nams can dge zhing legs pa/ 'dzangs shing bkra shis pa/ don dang ldan pa/ rang 'thad pa thams cad sdus sdus/ drag cing myur ba rgyun chad med pa bdag gi dbang du sdus shig /rang dbang med par dbang du sdus sdus/

hri dza khug drongs/ zhes bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i phyogs bzhir/ ma nu sarba tsit+ta a kar+ṣa ya hrīḥzhes pa re re bri/ mtshams bzhir/ sarba lo ka hrī pho thams cad kyi yid hriṃ dza khug sdus zhes pa re re bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ a tri nṛ dza pā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa re re bri/ mu khyud gsum pa pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad byas pa'i phyogs bzhir/ sarba lo ka hrīṃ hrīṃ mi thams cad kyi mi nor bi dz+nyā na hriṃ dza khug /mtshams bzhir a nṛ ya ma dung hriṃ aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzhoṃ dzhoṃ la ri ta swā hā/ zhes bri'o// mu khyud bzhi pa la/ oṃ badz+ra be se ku ma me ku ma me/ kham de kham de/ yu re yu re/ has has hos hos/ sa re ti/ kam kam/ kum kum/ myas myas/ myos myos/ rmugs rmugs/ phu phu/ yam yam/ bya bya/ lce lce/ khug khug /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ had ti zungs la khrid lcags kyi sgo mo smyor chug /ra ba'i nang du sha ra ra/ a chu byi tsir tser/ yer yer/ 'dus 'dus/ mi dang mi ma yin pa 'dod pa'i yon tan dang bcas pa bdag gi dbang du drag cing myur la rgyun chad med par sdus shig /wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes bri/ phyi rim la 'od dmar po lcags kyu lta bus bskor la yig mgo nang bstan bya'o// (na)bcu gnyis pa mi snying sgul ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim lnga bskor ba'i lte ba la/ 'gro ba mi rnams kun gyi snying dung dung*/

breng breng*/ sgul sgul/ khug khug /hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥdzaḥdzaḥ sems yid rnams dbang po snying sgul cig /drag myur rgyun chad med par sgul cig ces bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya/ dzhoṃ dzhoṃ bho dha na sarba hrīḥ bh+ri gh+ra lam ya khug dzaḥ thar tha ya dhe ri ha na khri hrīṃḥ de ba bā yu a mu kaṃ mā ra ya khug hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'gro ba pho mo thams cad kyi snying dung dung breng breng 'ur 'ur sgul sgul/ khug khug /hri dza sgul cig /ces bri/ mu khyud gsum pa rtsibs brgyad du byas pa la/ shar nas rim pa bzhin/ oṃ bud+dha dzaḥ a pa rā tsi ta/ rat+na sarba/ ma sha ra na/ sarba tri ba/ swasti swā hā/ mi snying drag tu/ cher sgul cig /ces bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ pho thams cad kyi mi nor ha ra ha ra dzaḥhriṃ hūm̐/ mo thams cad kyi mi nor= zhes pho mo spel mar bri'o// mu khyud bzhi pa la/ oṃ sgul sgul/ sgul sgul/ ma nu ṣa tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ ma nu ṣa tsit+ta kha shi bam mi snying sgul sgul/ mi 'gram chog chog /hrīṃ hrīṃ/ sdus sdus/ ma nu ṣa kha shi bam swā hā/ oṃ yeng yeng*/ kham kham/ tsag tsag /dung dung*/ breng breng*/ tsit+ta ma nu ha ra ha ra dz+nyā na/ tsa la tsa la nṛ/ tsit+ta a ni/ tra ya ka ma ya rā ga ag+ne/ dza la dza la bā yu sā ra sā ra/ aṃ gu sha dzaḥdzaḥb shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bri'o// mu khyud lnga pa la/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hrī da hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ gha na pā ti ye swā hā/ oṃ hrī dzaḥ a pa rā tsi ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ dzam bha la ma hā kā la yak+she u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dzaṃ luṃ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa badz+ra rat+na tsi tra rā ga ru ge hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa ku be rā swā hā/ oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya/ nā ga rak+sha rā dza hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā rā dza tsit+ta te swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ma hā yo gi ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye hūm̐ na maḥ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ oṃ ma hā pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā swā hā/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī hūm̐ hrīḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇi ye swā hā/ oṃ bh+ri gu ni ba tam su bha ga swā hā/ oṃ de bi shi ma hā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu sa le ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ oṃ mu sa la hrīḥya āḥhri ma e s+t+waṃ/ oṃ yak+sha dhe ba ba su sarba rā dza ma nu ṣa sarba pā ba na ye swā hā/ 'gro ba mi rnams kyi snying sgul/ zhes bri/ de'i phyi ma 'od zer gyi phreng bas bskor/ yig mgo phyir bstan bya'o// (pa)bcu gsum pa mi nor rgyas byed kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i lte ba la/ bdag gi mi dang nor rdzas mnga' thang dar zhing rgyas la 'phel zhing phyug pa dang*/ mang zhing phyug la 'phan dar ba dang drags pa dang 'phel bar gyur cig

/ces bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la ni/ ma nu ṣa ba su nā nā kha dhe sam bho ā yuḥdz+nyā ṇa puṇ+ye kīrti dharma dha na/ me dhi sid+dhi pha la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru bha ba ti swā hā/ bdag gi mi nor thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bri/ mu khyud gsum pa rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i shar nas rim pa bzhin/ ma nu ṣa/ ba su dha na/ ma hā puṇ+ye puṇ+ye/ ma hā saṃ bho dha na/ swasti su pra ti/ ma hā sid+dhi satwa/ sid+dhi pha la bu dhi/ dha ni rat+na sid+dhi puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ bdag gi mi nor puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ zhes pa re re bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ oṃ a ma nu ṣa ba su na dhe dha na sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru bha ba ti/ zhes pa bri/ mu khyud lnga pa la 'dod gsol gang 'dod bri/ de'i phyi ru rin po che'i sgrom bu dang*/ shing ljon pa la sogs pa la/ bh+rūm̐ḥgyis mtshan pa bri/ yig mgo nang bstan du bya'o// (pha)bcu bzhi pa tshe dang longs spyod 'phel rgyas kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhir bskor ba'i lte ba la/ bdag gi tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par gyur cig /bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa rtsibs brgyad byas pa'i shar nas rim pa bzhin/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ zhes 'bru brgyad po'i 'bru re rtsibs la bri/ rtsibs mchan la/ oṃ ā yur ha ka ra pa te shar ha/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa la/

ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru btags pa bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad du byas pa la/ shar nas rim pa bzhin/ oṃ dha nam/ me dhi/ te bhi/ ni te/ ā yuḥ sam bho/ tsa ta/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na su bi nish+tsi ta te dz+wa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye/ ma hā puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃskār pa ri shud+dha dharmā te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wa re swā hā'i bar gyi tshe gzungs tshang ma bris pa'i mjug tu bdag gi tshe dang longs spyod dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /dpal dang*/ ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams kyi phung po dang longs spyod thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te mi nyams par gyur cig /ces bri/ de'i phyi rim mu khyud la 'od zer 'phro ba bri/ yi ge phyir bstan no// (ba)bco lnga pa gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo bri ba ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhir bskor ba'i lte ba la/ bdag cag la nor rdzas tshe dpal mi g.yang*/ mthu stobs/ shes rab/ blo gros/ chos srid/ yon tan bsod nams kyi dngos grub chen po stsol cig /ces bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā/

oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ yak+ṣa ba su de ba sarba sid+dhi pha la a la la hoḥ zhes bri/ mu khyud gsum pa rtsibs brgyad du byas la/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li mā li ya swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa ran+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes shar nas rim pa bzhin du bri'o// rtsibs mchan brgyad pad+mar byas pa la/ shar lho nas rim pa bzhin/ oṃ tsan+d+rā ken+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dadatā yai swā hā/ oṃ de wi shrī yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swat+yai yai swā hā/ zhes bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pā ta ye/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra yak+sha ma hā kā la a pa ra mā ra dun+ti 'ub 'ub shang ka ra tsa'i snod ma hā rita ti yā ya rbad rbad/ gzhan nga la chod chod byo zhig /byo thongs/ thub sha la nag po sa ma ya sid+dhi hriṃ hriṃ byo byo dngos grub thams cad khug cig ces bri/ phyi rim la 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pas bskor la yig mgo nang bstan bya'o// (ma)bcu drug pa bgegs srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ ma hā kro dha sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ya ma tri khri ba ya ya lo ka bha ta ya rbad/ oṃ ya ya bhi/ ya ya hūm̐/ tri ma re phaṭa/ sarba bud+dha mā ra ya rbad/ oṃ gu ya gha na pa ti swā hā/ bdag cag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad a pa na ye zlog bh+yo mā ra ya rbad sod ces bri'o// mu khyud gnyis pa rtsibs brgyad du byas pa la/ gaḥbargyad bri'o// rtsibs mchan la/ bdag cag la gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad srungs shig /ces bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ tad+ya thā/ na ma ru te ka tra ka tra/ ma tra ma tra/ da ra da ra/ da ha da ha/ ghṛh+ṇa ghṛh+ṇa/ bhañdza bhañdza/ na mo tu te ru ru tsa na ye swā hā/ a bhu tra si na ru/ kha na man tsa tra ra ba sa gang tsha ti ha ha hi k+ṣi ta nan pra nan sa ka ya ya mi ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ na mo na ma swā hā/ sarba pā pam/ bdag la dgra bgegs las srungs shig /tad+ya thā/ lo ka li ā li kā li mu tsi ta swā hā/ t+yok+ṣi ba ga wa ti ni dhi swā hā/ zhes bri/ lag na rdo rje drag po'i sngags/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i mig /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ gtum po khyung sham can/ rdo rje srin po gnod sbyin srung ma chen po/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms byed/ bgegs dgra'i gzungs/ bgegs sel ba'i gnod mdzes kyi rtog pa/ rta mgrin/ mi g.yo ba/ 'byung po kun 'dul/ gshin rje chos rgyal la sogs pa'i sngags rnams bri bar bshad/ phyi rim la me 'bar 'khrugs pa dang*/

mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bri/ yig mgo phyir bstan no// (tsa)bcu bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i lte ba la/ dbus su ri bo mchog rab gru bzhi pa la/ hūm̐ lam hūm̐ brtsegs ma dang*/ de'i sham la bhū mi āḥhūm̐ bri/ de'i mtha' skor du/ gser gyi ri bdun mchod rten gyi dbyibs mgo nang du bstan pas bskor/ de'i phyi rim la rgya mtsho sngon po zlum skor gyi nang du/ gling bzhi dang*/ gling phran brgyad bri ste/ shar du gru bzhi/ lho ru sog kha/ nub tu zla gam/ byang du gru gsum gnyis bri'o// de'i phyi nas lcags ri'i 'khor yug gis bskor/ ri bdun gyi bar du rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ shar nub kyi nyi zla gnyis bris pa'i mtshams su/ oṃ ha ma su me ra we na ma/ zhes pa tshar gnyis gsum bri/ shar gyi gling gru bzhi la/ oṃ yaṃ pur+ṇa bi de ha ya na ma/ shar lho'i gling la/ oṃ ya u dwī pa ya na ma/ lho'i gling sog kha la/ oṃ raṃ dzaṃ bu dwī pa ya na ma/ lho nub kyi gling sog kha la/ oṃ ra u pa dwī pa ya na ma/ nub kyi gling zla gam la/ oṃ laṃ pa ra go dā nī ya na ma/ nub byang gi gling zla gam la/ oṃ la u pa dwī pa ya na ma/ byang gi gling gru gsum la/ oṃ wang urta ra ku ra bai na ma/ byang shar gyi gling gru gsum la/ oṃ wang u pa dwī pa na ma/ zhes re re la bskor ba bri/

lcags ri la/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐ bri'o// mu khyud gnyis pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i rtsibs la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi sngags bri ste/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du phyogs bzhi la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ma hā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ma hā pū dza= oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke= oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe= zhes gong dang 'dra ba bri/ shar lho nas rim pa bzhin du mtshams bzhi la/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye= oṃ badz+ra mā le= oṃ badz+ra gīrtī= oṃ badz+ra nīrtī= zhes bri'o// rtsibs mchan la rin po che'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa dar gyis mgul bcings pa brgyad bri'o// mu khyud gsum pa re khā brgyad du byas pa la/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi sngags bris te/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ oṃ tsakra rat+na ma hā pū dza hoḥ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na= oṃ wa ti rat+na= oṃ pu ru ṣa rat+na= oṃ hasti rat+na= oṃ tu raṅga rat+na= oṃ khaṅga rat+na= oṃ wa ma hā ni dhi na ya na maḥ zhes bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ phyogs bzhir/ shar dkar/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang bar byas/ yig mgo nang bstan du bya/ (tsha)bco brgyad pa sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ swasti sid+dhi pha la/ ma hā sid+dhi pha la sarba sid+dhi shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya sid+dhi pha la dza la hūm̐/

ā we sha ya a a ā/ zhes bri/ mu khyud gnyis par lam brgyad bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i sngags bri ba ni/ oṃ pṛ thi bi de bī sa pa ri wā ra dngos grub thams cad thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod gsol gang 'dod bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad du byas pa la 'dod gsol bri ba ni/ shar nas rim pa bzhin chos kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ mthu'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ rin po che sna lnga'i dngos grub= 'bru dang mi thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i dngos grub= zas thams cad dbang = g.yag rta ra lug sogs srog chags sems can= bdag la gnod sbyin nor lha thams cad 'du zhing 'grub pa'i= yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ zhes pa bri/ mu khyud lnga pa la 'dod gsol rgyas par bri/ yig mgo phyir bstan bya'o// de dag ni rtsa ba'i 'khor lo bco brgyad do// //rlung 'khor yid bzhin nor bu'i lugs kyi 'khor lo gang 'dzug kyang*/ sku gsung thugs tshe sgrub kyi 'khor lo dang bzhi ni man ngag gi 'khor lo ste/ de yang sku'i 'khor lo ni rigs lnga yab kyi 'khor lo ste steng gi 'khor lo/ gsung gi 'khor lo ni rigs lnga yum gyi 'khor lo ste 'og gi 'khor lo/ thugs kyi 'khor lo ni 'khyams ldog bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o// tshe sgrub kyi 'khor lo ni lus la bcang ba'i 'khor lo yin no//

( oṃ )dang po sku'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim bzhir bskor ba'i lte ba la/ oṃ gnyis bar du yi dam gyi sa bon de la dzi na dzik ces pas bskor/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam gyi rtsa sngags bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir byas pa'i shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛk /swā rat+na dh+rik /āṃ a ro lik /hā pra dz+nyā dhṛk /ces pa bri/ mtshams bzhir 'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon/ suṃ khaṃ raṃ yaṃ/ bzhi shar lho nas rim pa bzhin tshig re bri/ mu khyud bzhi pa la/ phyag na rdo rje'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ sogs phyag rdor gyi sngags gang shes rnams bri/ phyi rim 'od zer dkar pos bskor/ yig mgo phyir bstan bya/ sa lta'i 'khor lo yin na kha dog dkar po bya'o// (āḥ)gnyis pa gsung gi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhir bskor ba'i lte ba la/ hrīḥganyis kyi bar yi dam gyi sa bon/ de la lāṃ dā+e ṣa ra ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas bskor/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam gyi rtsa sngags bri/ mu khyud gsum pa rtsibs bzhir byas pa la/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ mūṃ dhā twī shwa rī/ māṃ mo ha ra ti/ pyāṃ rā ga ra ti/ tāṃ badz+ra ra ti zhes pa rnams bri/ rtsibs mchan bzhi la 'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon/ suṃ khaṃ raṃ yaṃ/ bzhi rim pa bzhin bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/

gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bid+yā rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ces pa'i bar bri'o// phyi rim la 'od zer gyi phreng bas bskor/ yig mgo nang bstan bya/ gnam lta'i 'khor lo yin pas kha dog dmar po bya'o// (hūm̐)gsum pa thugs kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte ba la/ hūm̐ gnyis kyi bar du yi dam gyi sa bon bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa rdo rje rgya gram du byas pa'i rwa dbus ma bzhi la a ka zhes pa tshar bzhi bri/ g.yas g.yon gyi rwa brgyad la badz+ra zhes pa brgyad bri/ mu khyud gsum pa la ā li bri/ a ā/ i ī= mu khyud bzhi pa la kā li bri/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ zhes bri/ phyi rim 'od zer dmar pos bskor/ yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas skor du bya'o// thugs kyi 'khor lo 'di 'khyams pa dang ldog pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yin pas 'khor lo thams cad kyi steng du bzhag par bya'o/ kha dog sngon po bya'o// (hrīḥ)bzhi pa tshe sgrub bh+rūm̐ḥgyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lngar bskor ba'i lte ba la/ brum/ lam/ tam/ gsum brtsegs mar zung gcig g.yas g.yon du bris pa'i mthar tshe'i snying po bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu byas la/ rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam gyi sa bon zung re bris pa'i bar du/ 'chang ba'i ming la rak+ṣa btags pa bri/

mu khyud bzhi pa 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bzhir byas pa'i rtsibs la rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam gyi sa bon zhal phyir bstan pa bri/ rtsibs mchan la che ge mo'i gnod pa zlogs zhes pa bri/ mu khyud lnga pa la/ rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam gyi sngags kyi sham bur che ge'i gnod pa zlogs zhes bri/ phyi rim la rdo rje'i rwa ba dang me ris bskor/ tshe sgrub kyi 'khor lo 'di ni bris tshar ba dang*/ dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag la/ 'khor lo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan gyi ngo bor bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan dang byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus 'khor lo la thim pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan gyi ngo bor gyur par bsam la me tog gtor/ bkra shis brjod/ bsrung bya'i mgul du mgo mjug ma log par btags/ yon tan gyi 'khor lo yin no// (hā)lnga pa mtshon cha rdo rje'i 'khor lo ni/ dmigs pa'i dgra bo des rlung 'khor 'dzugs pa shes na/ de bshig pa'i 'khor lo yin te/ mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i lte ba la/ rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam sa bon oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa bri/ mu khyud gnyis pa la rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu /phyogs re la ral gri lnga lngas mtshan pa la/ ra ba rnams su pha rol gyi ming yig dang po bri/

mu khyud gsum pa la/ rang gang sgrub kyi yi dam gyi rtsa sngags dang sbrel ma'i spu gri'i mtshams rnams su/ che ge'i rlung 'khor shigs/ gtubs zhes pa bcug /phyi rim la me ris bskor/ 'khor lo 'di bris tshar ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las kyi ngo bor bsam la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus pas 'khor lo la thim/ phrin las kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam la/ me tog 'thor bkra shis brjod la/ rang gi dpung pa g.yon pa la btags/ sngags bzlas pas pha rol rlung 'khor dang bcas pa gtub bshig par bsam mo/ /gong gi 'khor lo rnams kyi yig 'bru dbu can/ sngags rnams tshag shad med par sbrul 'khyil ba ltar bri/ mis ma mthong bar bya/ sman dang spos dang rin po che'i phye mas byug /'khor lo de rnams kyi bca' lugs shog gu zlum po ji ltar 'tsham pa dgu la/ 'khor lo bco brgyad po bris la/ dang po la skyob pa gdugs kyi 'khor lo/ ma lto la gnyan po thog zer gyi 'khor lo bri/ de'i 'og tu ya lto la/ sbyin pa spel ba'i 'khor lo bri/ ma lto la 'bru spel ba'i 'khor lo bris la bca' 'o// de'i 'og tu ya lto la kha drag dpung bskyed pa/ ma lto la khrom zil gnon bris te bca' 'o/ de'i 'og tu ya lto la 'khon sbyong ba bri/

ma lto la lha dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa bris la bca'/ de'i 'og tu ya lto la rang gang byed nor lha'i 'khor lo/ ma lto la dngos grub byin 'beb kyi 'khor lo bca' 'o// de'i 'og tu ya lto la khams gsum dbang sdud/ ma lto la mi snying sgul ba bris la bca'/ de'i 'og tu ya lto la mi nor rgyas byed/ ma lto la tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas pa bca' 'o// de'i 'og tu ya lto la gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo/ ma lto la bgegs srung ba'i 'khor lo bca'/ de'i 'og tu ya lto la mchod pa 'bul ba'i 'khor lo/ ma lto la sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'khor lo bris la bca' 'o// 'khor lo bco brgyad po de dag gi lha dang 'khon sbyong ba dang*/ lha dang lus grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa gnyis zhi ba'i 'khor lo'o// mi nor rgyas byed dang*/ tshe dang longs spyod rgyas byed/ 'bru 'phel ba dang*/ sbyin pa spel ba dang*/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu dang*/ rang gang byed nor lha'i 'khor lo dang drug po rgyas pa'i 'khor lo'o/ khams gsum dbang sdud dang*/ dngos grub byin 'beb/ mi snying sgul ba/ khrom zil gnon gyi 'khor lo bzhi po dbang gi 'khor lo'o// gnyen po thog zer dang*/ bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ kha drag dpung bskyed kyi 'khor lo ste gsum drag po'i 'khor lo'o/ skyob pa gdugs dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba/
sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'khor lo ste gsum spyi khyab kyi 'khor lo yin no// de ltar 'khor lo bco brgyad po rim par brtsegs pa'i steng du/
sku/
rigs lnga yab kyi 'khor lo steng du byed pa sa lta'o//
gsung*/

rigs lnga yum gyi 'khor lo 'og tu byed pa gnam lta'o// log gnon thugs kyi 'khor lo bri na kun gyi steng du bca' 'o// 'khor lo rnams zlum por bskor ba'i mthar shog skya ser po sor re tsam bya/ sman dang dri bzang gis byugs/ gu gul gyis bdug ste bgegs bskrad/ gzhi dkar po'am/ rin po che'i snod du 'khor lo rnams bkram ste/ mi dmigs pa las 'khor lo rnams bris pa 'dra ba'i dam tshig pa bskyed la ye shes sems dpa' dang byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim/ 'khor lor bris pa'i sngags rnams dang rten 'brel snying po bzlas shing rab gnas bya'o// de nas 'khor lo rnams steng 'og ma 'chugs par byas la mtha' nas dar skud kyi dkris sam/ smyug ma gshags pa'am shing gang yang rung ba rgya gram du byas pa'i bar du 'khor lo bsdam/ rlung gshog bzhi la/ hūm̐ mūṃ/ oṃ lāṃ/ swā māṃ/ āṃ pyāṃ/ hā tāṃ rnams kha sbyor du byas pa'i rgyab tu/ e yaṃ/ raṃ baṃ/ suṃ rnams bri/ smyug ma gshags pa dar skud kyis btsems la rlung gshog phreng ba bya/ srog shing rtse mo la 'khor lo gdugs lta bu yong ba bya/ steng khang 'og khang byas pas steng khang du 'khor lo/ 'og khang du rlung gshog 'khor ba'i rlung 'khor lo la mi 'phog par byed pa man ngag yin no/

/'khor lo bskor zhing sgrub pa ni/ zhag dus tshes grangs bzang po la tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams te 'khor lo 'dzugs/ phyi rlung nang rlung bsre ba dang*/ dug dbyung ba'i man ngag mchod rten du 'dzugs pa'i 'khor lo dang 'dra la/ rab gnas byas shing me tog 'thor la bkra shis brjod/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams rang rang gi pho brang du bzhugs pa nas tshur byon/ 'khor lor thim par bsam zhing smon lam 'di skad gdab bo// oṃ swasti swasti/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med par bcas pa rnams la bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum mos shing gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod gtor rgya chen po 'bul lo// thugs mnyes shing dgyes pa rab kyi mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/ na mo dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'khor lo rin po che 'di rnams nam zla dus bzhir 'byung ba rlung gis 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthu dang nus pa dang*/ gzi brjid dang dpung dang byin rlabs dang 'od zer gyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams tshe rabs 'di nas bzung nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo rin po che dus rgyun chad med par bskor bar gyur cig /zhal zas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rin po che dus rgyun chad med par bskor bar gyur cig /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor lo rin po che dus rgyun chad med par bskor bar gyur cig

/hrīḥ nor lha'i rgyal po a pa rā tsi ta yab yum dang 'khor gnod sbyin pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub rin po che ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du myur du 'grub par gyur cig /gnod sbyin nor lha'i rgyal po zhang dbon dang*/ rnam thos sras dang*/ dzaṃ bha la dang*/ nor rgyun ma dang*/ dpal chen mo dang*/ ga ṇa pa ti tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang*/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs te gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i 'khor lo rin po che 'byung ba rlung gis nam zla dus bzhir bskor bas/ 'jig rten khams kyi gser dngul zangs lcags g.yu gos/ khrab 'bru dang rin po che dang*/ mchod cha dar zab gos l+h+wam/ sha mar bza' btung 'dod yon sna dgu /dkor nor sna bco brgyad rta dang glang po bang mdzod ra lug phyugs mi nor gyi bang mdzod ma lus pa la sogs pa rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ longs spyod dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod chen po la dbang bsgyur bar gyur cig /hrīḥ dmar po dbang gi 'khor lo bskor bas khams gsum dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /khrom zil gnon gyi 'khor lo bskor bas srid gsum zil gyis non par gyur cig /dngos grub byin 'beb kyi 'khor lo bskor bas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad lhun grub tu 'byung bar gyur cig

/skyob pa gdugs kyi 'khor lo bskor bas dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par gyur cig /kha drag dpung bskyed pa'i 'khor lo bskor bas kha drag dpung pa phyogs med du rgyas par gyur cig /'bru spel ba'i 'khor lo bskor bas 'bru'i bang mdzod chen po la longs spyod par gyur cig /mi nor rgyas pa'i 'khor lo bskor bas bdag cag mi nor thams cad rgyas par gyur cig /dbang du bya ba'i 'khor lo bskor bas 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig /mi snying sgul ba'i 'khor lo bskor bas mi snying rang dbang med par 'gul bar gyur cig /tshe dang longs spyod spel ba'i 'khor lo bskor bas bdag gi tshe dang longs spyod dpal dang gzi brjid kha rje dbang thang thams cad dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /tshe ring zhing nad med pa bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub chen po thob par gyur cig /sbyin pa spel ba'i 'khor lo bskor bas/ bdag gi sbyin pa'i dngos po thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /lha dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i 'khor lo bskor bas/ bdag la skyob par byed pa'i lha dang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i 'khor lo bskor bas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs kyis mi tshugs par gyur cig

/khams gsum dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bskor bas 'dzam bu'i gling gi skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ mi phyug po dang*/ phyug mo dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ rgyal mo dang*/ blon po dang*/ dge bshes dang*/ gnas brtan dang*/ che btsun dang*/ mi chen dra ma dang*/ che dgu thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hrī dzaḥkhug /mgo nag mi thams cad dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /dgyes pa mchod pa'i 'khor lo bskor bas/ nor lha'i tshogs la mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /tsakra rat+na s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces 'khor lo'i sngags dang 'od zer phyi la spros te bskor bas sngags dang 'od zer gyi nus pa thams cad 'gro ba mi rnams kyi snying la 'thim par gyur cig /snying la 'thim pas bdag la ma dad pa dang log par lta ba rnams bsregs bcom med par byas nas bdag cag la dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur cig /tsakra rat+na saṃ ha ra ṇa/ zhes 'khor lo'i sngags dang 'od zer rnams nang du 'dus te bskor bas 'jig rten khams kyi rtsi bcud lo thog rnams dang*/ 'gro ba rnams kyi rnam par shes pa thams cad rang dbang med par bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /'khor lo 'di'i 'od zer dmar po drag la myur ba 'tsher zhing 'phros pas lcags kyu lta bus stong khams kyi lha dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang gzi brjid thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing khug par gyur cig

/'gro ba mi rnams kyi snying gi dkyil nas rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nṛḥnya mig lta bu gcig yod pa de rnams 'od kyis rang dbang med par drangs nas bdag gi snying la 'thim pas mgo nag mi yi rnam par shes pa thams cad rang dbang med par bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /mdor na 'khor lo rin po che 'di rnams bskor bas bdag gi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa rnams myur du 'grub par gyur cig /sid+dhi sid+dhi/ pha la pha la/ rat+na rat+na/ tsakra tsakra /swasti swasti bha wa ti/ dza ya dza ya/ sā dhu sā dhu/ zhes smon lam btab/ smon lam ltar dmigs pa yang bsgom/ rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la 'bru gtor/ smon lam ltar dmigs pa yang bsgom/ smon lam 'di ni tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po 'grub sbyor yod pa la yang yang gdab bo// tshogs dang phud gtor bzang po bshams pa rnams chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ 'khor lo yig mgos sna drangs te g.yas skor du 'khor bar bya/ rlung khang la gzungs thag btags te sne nas bzung la rang gi yi dam sngags la gang 'dod kyi sham bu btags la/ 'khor lo la bris pa'i sngags rnams bzlas la/ 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba las 'od zer sna tshogs pa spros te/ 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs spros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib chag che nyam nga lha mkhon btsog grib byad phur rbod gtong thams cad zhi bar bsam/

'od zer ser po'i tshogs spros pas bsod nams dang longs spyod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam/ 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs 'phros pas lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad dbang du 'dus shing*/ zil gyis non par bsam/ 'od zer nag po'i tshogs 'phros pas gdug pa can bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam/ 'od zer mchod pa'i sprin dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams mchod/ dngos grub char ltar 'beb par bsam mo// de ltar rlung gis 'khor lo bskor bas 'dzam bu gling gi mi nor thams cad dbang du bsgyur zhing longs spyod par 'gyur/ mgo nag mi thams cad dbang du 'dus/ che btsun thams cad bran du khol/ bud med thams cad kyi yid 'phrog /mi snying thams cad rang dbang med par 'gul/ yid la 'dod dgu 'grub par 'gyur ro// ༈ //smon lam bsdus pa ni/ na mo/ ye shes dang las la grub pa rnams dang 'brel ba'i stobs/ bdag la 'go zhing sdongs grogs byed pa rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag la dus dang rnam pa kun tu dam pa'i chos thams cad dang*/ 'chi med kyi tshe dang*/ brgyud 'dzin gyi srid dang*/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs/ sgrib med kyi ye shes/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes/ lhun grub kyi phrin las/

nus mthu'i rtsal shugs/ snyan grags kyi gtam/ dge legs kyi bkra shis/ khas drag gi mchog /zil gnon gyi gzi byin/ bsam 'grub dang bde skyid 'khor lo'i tshogs chen po/ rten 'brel rdzas/ dbang phyug dpal g.yang*/ mtshan ldan yum/ mi zad gter/ bran g.yog 'khor/ rtsa lag gnyen/ 'byor pa'i yo byad longs spyod/ nor rdzas bza' btung*/ bzang mdzes dro ba'i gos/ go mtshon rgyan 'bru/ phyugs dbyig dang gsum/ yul zhing mkhar/ chus srid mnga' thang*/ mi zad pa'i gter/ bdud 'dul mthu/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs/ re smon gyi bsam pa 'grub pa/ yid la 'dod pa 'grub pa'i mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thams cad/ drag tu myur du rgyun chad med par thob ste/ mi nyams par stsol cig /ces brjod do// ༈ //de yang bsdu na/ na mo/ ye shes dang las las grub pa'i ye shes kyi lha tshogs dang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyi ye shes kyi 'khor tshogs dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ bdag la 'go zhing sdongs grogs byed pa rnams dang*/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag la dus gsum kun tu mchog thun mong gi sid+dhi thams cad dang*/ tshe dang chos srid yon tan dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ gter dang longs spyod dang*/ yo byad dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ nor rdzas dang*/ zas dang*/ dbyig dang*/ rat+na dang*/ 'bru dang*/ spu phyugs dang*/ gnyen dang*/ grogs dang*/ 'khor dang*/

g.yog dang*/ bran khol dang*/ snyan grags dang*/ 'dun gros dang*/ mngon shes dang*/ gzungs dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ shes rab dang*/ blo gros dang*/ mthu stobs gzi brjid dang*/ bde skyid dang*/ bsam 'grub dang*/ yul zhing khang khyim la sogs ci 'dod pa don du 'gyur ba thams cad stsol cig /drag myur rgyun chad med par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab bo// ༈ //'di'i rgyab chos bum gter 'dzugs pa'i man ngag ni/ rdza bum gsar pa'i nang du spra tshil la klu nor rgyas kyi gzugs dkar po sor brgyad pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha byad can/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun yod pa/ g.yas rin po che 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon ut+pal bsnams pa/ lte ba man chod sbrul du yod pa/ yum gyi gzugs kyang de dang 'dra ba la sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka lnga yod pa/ thal mo sbyar nas yab la gzigs pa/ de gnyis lto sbyar la ghi hang gis byugs/ oṃ nā ga nā ga du du phuḥphuḥ zhes bris pa/ klu'i gzugs kyi nang du gzhug /de pad+ma dang nas kyi gdan la bzhag /rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ sman lnga/ bcud zas dar zab/ mngar gsum/ phyug po dgu'i zhing sa/ g.yang ma nyams pa'i bre srang dgu'i dreg pa/ phyugs zal chags dgu'i spu/ ri bo ri'i rtse mo'i sa/ lung pa'i srol lnga'am sa bkra bzang po'i chu rnams bum par blugs la dar gyis mgul chings bya/ ting nge 'dzin phyogs bcu'i dpal 'byor rtsi bcud/

dbang dang dngos grub bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ dpal g.yang yon tan thams cad bstim zhing rab gnas bya/ ra ba bzhi'i nya'i nyin chu mig kha shar bltas su gter du sba bar bya/ khyad par 'bru nor 'phel bar 'dod na mdzod kyi phug /phyugs 'phel bar 'dod na ra ba'i dkyil/ byis pa 'phel bar 'dod na byis pa mang po'i rtsed rar sba bar bshad do// rlung 'khor bum gter bca' thabs kyi man ngag go /rlung 'khor bcas chog ma 'di'i 'khor lo rnams mis reg mthong med par byas la rang gi gnas su bcang ngo*// ༈ //gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ 'khor lo rnams bsdus la mchod khang mdzod phug tu bzhugs su gsol/ tshogs gtang rag rgyas par bya/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// rlung 'khor yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag mkha' 'gro rlung 'khor bcas chog ma zhes pa 'di ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi lugs te/ grub thob chen po bram ze sdom pa bzang pos 'gram lo tsā ba chen po dharmā bid+yā la chig brgyud du byas te/ man ngag rnams/ 'khor lo rnams dang 'gyur shog gi smon lam gnyis la rgya dpe yod pa yang snang*/ de la lo tsā bas 'gyur mdzad/ gser srang lnga'i maṇ+ḍal phul te snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rnams yi ger bkod par gsol ba btab nas dkar chag dang lag len mdor bsdus yi ger bkod/ de nas rim par brgyud de sngags 'chang rig 'dzin la'o// me rlung gnyis kyi las ni rno zhing myur la thogs med 'grub pa yin pas/

de'i nang nas khyad par rlung 'khor yid bzhin nor bu 'di byin rlabs che zhing 'khor lo bcas pa nyid kyis dngos grub thob/ mkha' 'gro rlung 'khor yid bzhin nor bu bcas chog ma zhes bya ba'i lag len khrigs chags su zhal gdams rnams dkyus su bcug ste yi ger bkod pa chos bdag mkha' 'gros gnang ba mdzad cing dge legs su gyur cig /shu bhaṃ// ༈ //dgos 'dod ma lus sgrub byed pa'i// gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams la// kun nas dad gus drag po yis// lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'khor lo rin chen bcas chog gi man ngag zab mo 'di la/ yon tan bsgrub mi dgos te 'byung ba rlung la las bcol bas chog /de'ang lung las/ rlung zhes bya ba las kun byed// ces pas srid pa phyi nang gnyis ka rlung la brten te/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags 'jig 'phel lugs dang lo tog rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyang 'byung ba rlung gi stobs kyis byed/ nang bcud kyi sems can gyi smra ba 'gro nyal 'dug sdod skye rga na 'chi/ dga' mi dga'/ rdzu 'phrul mngon shes/ bde sdug /gang stong*/ yod med/ phan gnod ma lus pa kun 'byung ba rlung gi stobs kyis byed/ de phyir 'byung ba rlung gi 'khor los las kun byed pas na/ rlung gi 'khor lo'i gnad mi shes pa'i gang zag kun/ ri mo sna tshogs bris nas 'khor lo yin zer ba na yid smon tsam yin no// 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni mi sdod par 'khor ba gcig gis las 'grub cing byin rlabs 'byung ba yin no// dper na gser gyi 'khor lo bskor bas kyang bug pa 'bug pa dang 'dra'o// 'khor lo rgyun du 'khor ba yin// de phyir 'byung ba rlung 'khor 'di// mi sdod 'khor bas las kun byed// zas nor longs spyod 'byung ba dang*// ngag sbyor ci bcol ma lus 'grub// gnad kyi gdams ngag rin chen 'di byas na// 'dzam gling dgos 'dod ma lus thams cad la// yid la ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'byung 'gyur te// bcas chog lan gcig 'khor bas yon tan sna re 'byung*// gsungs pas rgyun du 'khor ba'i phan yon ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo*// gnad yig 'phrul gyi me long las/

dang po nor lha bsgrub par bya// las mtha' rlung 'khor legs byas nas// gang 'dod sid+dhi 'grub par 'gyur// zhes sogs/ rmi lam du ni lung bstan thob// spyir na las sbyor thams cad kyang*// me rlung gnyis kyis 'grub pa yin// mchog tu rlung gi 'khor lo ni// myur mgyogs shin tu che ba yin// de 'ang ji ltar yin ce na// 'jig rten 'di yi dgos 'dod kun// 'byung ba lnga la ma brten par// 'byung ba rgyal bas ma gsungs so// 'byung ba lnga yi nang nas kyang*// rlung las myur mgyogs che ba med// de'i phyir rlung la las bcol nas// sid+dhi myur mgyogs rlung dang 'dra// rlung 'khor man ngag shes pa de// rin chen gter dang 'phrad pa yin// 'di 'dra'i man ngag kun la med// gces par zungs shig snying gi bu// shes rab chung la brtson 'grus zhan// de 'dras 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// me yi las su sbyin sreg ni// las rnams kun la shis pa yin// sngags rnams nus pa 'grub byed pa// sbyin sreg yin par rgyal bas gsungs// de phyir me rlung gnyis po ni// las sbyor kun la shis pa yin// gnad yig 'phrul gyi me long*// bkra shis so/// /
